listing.headline: Modern Living, Designed in Warm Wood and Light
listing.description: Built in 2025, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath contemporary pairs cedar plank and charcoal finishes with floor-to-ceiling glass for a home that feels open, bright, and grounded. A chef’s kitchen with a large island flows into the open living and dining space, while upstairs the primary suite opens onto a private balcony with a walk-in closet and spa-style bath. A guest suite, flexible loft or office, smart home system, solar-ready roof, and attached 2-car garage complete 3,240 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living.
